rationale: This is a blown-out parabolic move on a $3.5M microcap with a 1.03M-share float — price more than doubled intraday, then collapsed ~46% off the high and is now chopping sideways in a tight 14-cent band on steadily dying volume (112k → 31k per 5-min bar) near session lows. Going long has no evidence of buyers stepping in with 8 minutes to the close, and going short means unknown borrow availability on a low-float name where most of the flush already occurred, with squeeze/halt gap risk. Any entry here forces overnight exposure into an unwinding pump with unquantifiable gap risk in either direction, so the edge in both directions is insufficient to justify taking it.
